segments.ja: 遠征の前夜、キース・シャーディスがエレンの前に座ります。座る理由は、グリシャの到着を見た人間が、まだ生きているからです。生きている教官は、自分を特別だと思っていた過去を話します。話す過去は、壁の外で一人の男を拾った朝です。朝の男が、記憶を失った顔で、壁の中へ入りました。入った男の名が、グリシャです。グリシャは、後にカルラとエレンの家を持ちます。
segments.en: On the night before the expedition, Keith Shadis sits in front of Eren. The reason he sits is that a human who saw Grisha's arrival is still alive. The instructor who is alive tells a past in which he thought himself special. The past he tells is a morning when he picked up one man outside the wall. The man of the morning entered inside the walls with a face that had lost its memory. The name of the man who entered is Grisha. Grisha later has a house with Carla and Eren.

segments.ja: キースは、調査兵団で特別な兵士になりたかった人間です。なりたかった夢が、壁の外の死者の数で削られます。削られた自尊心のところに、グリシャが現れます。現れた男は、医者であり、壁の中の常識の外を知っているように見えました。見えた知識を、キースは自分の特別さを証明する鍵だと思いました。思った鍵は、他人の物語でした。物語の主人公は、教官ではありません。
segments.en: Keith is a human who wanted to become a special soldier in the Survey Corps. The dream of wanting to become one is shaved by the number of the dead outside the walls. Grisha appears at the place of the shaved pride. The man who appeared was a doctor, and he looked as if he knew the outside of common sense inside the walls. Keith thought the knowledge he saw was a key that proved his own specialness. The key he thought was someone else's story. The protagonist of the story is not the instructor.

segments.ja: カルラは、キースに、エレンを特別な子にしないでくれ、と願います。願う母は、息子が普通に生きることを選びます。選ぶ言葉を、教官は完全には守れません。守れなかった理由は、少年の目が父に似て、壁の外を見ていたからです。見ていた目を、彼は訓練で何度も見ます。見るたびに、傍観者の位置が痛くなります。痛くなっても、物語の中心には入れません。入れないことが、この回の題です。
segments.en: Carla asks Keith not to make Eren a special child. The mother who asks chooses that her son live ordinarily. The instructor cannot keep the words she chooses completely. The reason he could not keep them is that the boy's eyes resembled the father and were looking outside the walls. He sees the eyes that were looking, many times in training. Each time he sees them, the bystander's position hurts. Even hurting, he cannot enter the center of the story. Not being able to enter is the title of this episode.

segments.ja: グリシャの家は、シガンシナ区の普通の診療所に見えました。見えた普通の下に、地下室があります。地下室の鍵を、父は息子に預け、壁が落ちる日に外へ出ます。出た父は、レイスの祠へ向かった人間です。向かった夜を、キースはすべて見てはいません。見ていない部分を、彼は傍観者の限界として語ります。語る限界は、エレンが今日持つ記憶より少ないです。少ない証言でも、父が外から来た事実は固まります。
segments.en: Grisha's house looked like an ordinary clinic in Shiganshina District. Under the ordinary that was seen, there is a basement. The father leaves the basement key with his son, and on the day the wall falls he goes outside. The father who went out is the human who headed to the Reiss chapel. Keith does not see all of the night he headed. He tells the part he does not see as the limit of a bystander. The limit he tells is less than the memory Eren holds today. Even the smaller testimony firms the fact that the father came from outside.

segments.en: Carla's wish is not to become the mother of a hero. It is a dinner her son comes home to. The dinner vanished on the day the wall fell. Keith holds the vanished wish as a regret he could not protect. The regret he holds is the training in which he treated Eren as special. The fact remains that at the edge of training he wanted to make him fail, and could not. He tells the fact that remained as a defeat of the mother's words. The defeat he tells is, for Eren, kind information. The kind information is: you are also your mother's ordinary son.

segments.en: Keith was looking at the whole of training as a bystander. Inside what he was looking at are Armin's head, Mikasa's strength, and Jean's wavering. segments.en: On the day Shiganshina's wall fell, Keith was at the edge of the scene. From the edge, he sees Carla left behind, Grisha searching for Eren, and the house becoming fire. The place he sees is a distance that cannot save. The distance that cannot save completes the definition of bystander. He does not use the completed definition as an excuse. The confession he does not use is set in front of Eren. The confession that was set is too late. Even too late, it is in time for the night before the expedition.

segments.en: Eren does not receive the conclusion that he was not chosen as an insult. The reason he does not receive it that way is that a memory remains of having wanted his mother's ordinary life. The memory that remains lines up with the bone of his father's sin. He holds the two that lined up as both true. Holding them steps down from the story of a special hero. From the place he stepped down, he goes to Shiganshina on his own feet. The decision to go is not the instructor's permission. It is his own key.
